pose: An expansive landscape composition showcasing a diverse Cretaceous pterosaur ecosystem arrayed across a lush tropical lagoon system. In the immediate foreground, a magnificent tapejarid (Tapejara) is perched proudly on a limestone outcropping, showing off its massive, brightly colored, sail-like cranial crest in a stable three-quarter profile. On the opposite side of the foreground, a specialized ctenochasmatid walks low along the variegated reddish-brown mud, its head lowered as it strains the shallow water through hundreds of comb-like bristle teeth. Along the bright, wide waterways of the midground, a group of large anhanguerids (Anhanguera) are active, some skim-feeding with their rounded, rounded-crest beaks open just above the water's surface, casting sharp reflections on the water. Anchoring the deep background, the expansive silhouettes of giant soaring pterosaurs glide effortlessly over the distant, hazy coastal horizons under a high-key tropical sky, creating a powerful sense of primeval scale.
